description: start_twist_90 on a chain running down -X. The start control's own X points up the chain (+X), so rotateX 90 turns the control 90 about world +X, and its bind joint must turn with it: the ramp runs from 90 at u = 0 to 0 at u = 1, as turns about world +X of 90, 67.5, 45, 22.5 and 0. A ribbon that applied the angle about the chain's forward direction (-X) would turn the joints the other way, -90 at the start.
